eventAuthority: combat-events.js normalizeRaw; no new source types, damage, HP or audio
cancel: B1 signal/isCurrent; no additional timer or emission after cancel

crit.when: same attack with data.crit=true or revengeCrit=true

combo.eventOrder: original seq; no artificial event or damage
combo.composition: once for each source event; never invent additional hits

drain.hp: only authoritative checkpoint; do not infer healing or create hit
drain.posePolicy: retain current pose rather than duplicate attack

defeat.when: actor-defeated authoritative event, not action-budget truncation

reason: existing articulated actions plus source-event-specific silent cues suffice; not claiming four extra clips

critOrRevengeCrit.cue: replace base impact with crit color, never add a second sprite
critOrRevengeCrit.text: retain base label plus 暴擊

flagComposition.drain: requires its own source event; never infer healing from an attack flag
